claim: Assemble existing wet-lab pieces into NPY↔SOD1 disease-context wiring that STRING does not list as a PPI edge.
noveltyGate: STRING focus empty AND ≥3 independent wet-lab pieces spanning (A) NPY altered in SOD1/ALS tissue, (B) NPY functional effect in SOD1 models, (C) human ALS motor-cortex NPY change.
falsifiers: STRING gains a scored NPY–SOD1 PPI edge on re-query → demote to rediscovery wiring
Fewer than 3 pre-registered wet-lab pieces survive citation check → fail assembly
No SOD1-genotype or ALS-tissue piece → fail (disease-context bridge missing)
doesNotClaim: new wet-lab assay performed by us

pieces.title: Calretinin and Neuropeptide Y interneurons are differentially altered in the motor cortex of the SOD1G93A mouse model of ALS
pieces.whatItShows: NPY+ interneuron density altered in SOD1G93A motor cortex across disease stages.

pieces.title: Intranasal neuropeptide Y1 receptor antagonism improves motor deficits in symptomatic SOD1 ALS mice
pieces.cite: Clark et al., Ann Clin Transl Neurol 10:1985–1999 (2023)
pieces.whatItShows: Human ALS motor cortex NPY labelling ↑ (~75%); SOD1G93A cortical cultures + intranasal NPY/Y1 pharmacology alter excitability, motor deficits, survival signals.

pieces.title: Pathogenic or protective? Neuropeptide Y in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis
pieces.cite: Clark et al., J Neurochem (review; ALS/NPY mechanisms)
pieces.whatItShows: Synthesizes NPY roles in ALS pathways that SOD1 models also hitch (excitotoxicity, oxidative stress, hyperexcitability).

pieces.title: Astrocytes expressing mutant SOD1 trigger motoneuron death via nitroxidative stress
pieces.cite: Front. Cell. Neurosci. (SOD1 astrocyte ACM / nitroxidative stress)
pieces.whatItShows: Mutant SOD1 astrocytes drive motoneuron death through nitroxidative stress — the SOD1 disease wire NPY literature claims to modulate.
